top_signals.title: New Jersey Moves to Block Trump's Russian Diesel Imports
top_signals.summary: New Jersey Democratic Governor Mikie Sherrill warned port and terminal operators in the state against "purchasing or unloading the illegal Russian fuel currently bound for the east coast of the United States."  Sherrill's move threatens to complicate President Trump's efforts to bring Russian diesel into US markets to ease high industrial fuel prices amid a severe global refining squeeze fueled by Ukrainian drone attacks on Russian refineries and disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz. In a Monday letter, Sherrill urged operators to turn away…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.summary: Technology megacaps rallied, leading the broader stock market higher, as Democrats swept to power in Congress and President Donald Trump said he would accept the midterm results, easing uncertainty and prompting investors to buy the recent dip.
